final: WITH patient_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM patient_counts), shares AS (SELECT p.ID, p.record_count, 1.0 * p.record_count / t.total_count AS share FROM patient_counts AS p CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.record_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - m.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value
